Container.Name: Sara
Container.Overview:
Sara is a self-hosted AI companion and coding partner: chat, memory, a planner, coding tools, photos and voice, all on your own server. You choose the AI model (local with Ollama, or your own provider account); your data and keys stay in her data folder.
First start: open the WebUI within an hour and set Sara up in the browser with the 8-character setup code from the container's log (click the icon, then Logs; look for "setup code"). She then shows your owner token once: keep it in your password manager. Missed the hour? Restart the container for a new code. Lost the token later? docker exec Sara node src/main.ts --reset-token (then restart the container).
Plain HTTP is fine on your home network; for access from outside, put an HTTPS reverse proxy in front and set Secure cookies and Trust proxy to 1.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: ai assistant companion chatbot llm ollama coding self-hosted
Container.Requires: An AI model: Ollama (another container or machine) or an account with an AI provider. About 300 MB of memory for Sara herself.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Her data: database, memories, keys (encrypted), photos and backups. Back it up.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: 1 when you reach her through HTTPS (a reverse proxy).

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: 1 when a reverse proxy in front of her sets X-Forwarded-For.
